name: A Decoy Strike button is saved as Outmaneuver (#5469)
contract: Outmaneuver 557325 cast on an enemy runs spell_ascension_outmaneuver::Begin (AscensionRangerOutmaneuver.cpp:159), which summons the decoy 50171, applies the 8 s window 557326, learns Decoy Strike! 557328 as a temporary spell (learnSpell(SPELL_DECOY_STRIKE, true), line 183) and replaces Outmaneuver with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 184). A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before Outmaneuver is cast again, so a saved Decoy Strike! button would be refused and deleted at login. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding Decoy Strike! must be saved as Outmaneuver, and a button holding Outmaneuver itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Outmaneuver replaces itself with Decoy Strike!
The Decoy Strike! button is saved as Outmaneuver
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
